# Vesnea Vibe

Vesnea Vibe applies a sea-inspired colour palette taken from Seavalanche's Project Sea Web. It stays close to Obsidian's defaults and keeps the UI light, prioritizing legibility and accessibility, with italics highlighted by a green tint. The recorded description names Josefin Sans and Work Sans as the fonts it includes.

![Vesnea Vibe screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seavalanche/vesnea-obsidian-theme/HEAD/store-display.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Vesnea Vibe"
    author: "seavalanche"
    repo:   "seavalanche/vesnea-obsidian-theme"
    slug:   "vesnea-vibe"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/vesnea-vibe"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/seavalanche/vesnea-obsidian-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/seavalanche/vesnea-obsidian-theme/HEAD/store-display.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a sea-inspired color palette based on Seavalanche's Project Sea Web. Keep the UI light and close to Obsidian defaults while prioritizing legibility and accessibility. Highlight italics with a green tint and include Josefin Sans and Work Sans for a cohesive look."
}
```
